evidence: Read-only analysis of historical Test; NOT a new held-out test or any API replay.

cases.instruction: Pack exactly one cup and one block into the box, then cover it with one lid. Place the block before the cup. Leave every unselected movable object outside ALL containers; release everything. Each named preference has one fixed user choice; an undisclosed preference is unknown. For the lid, use item_5f929be596. For the cup, use item_e0770b7f63.
cases.observed_problem: Both gates continued before an unresolved required predecessor; the planner guessed a wrong block. No motion failure.
cases.interpretation: Model decision error under the explicit original contract. Lack of a concise known/unknown/order view is a repair hypothesis, not proof of internal model reasoning.

cases.instruction: Put one selected cup in its preferred container and one selected block in the OTHER container. The cup_destination preference chooses the cup's container and also determines the block's other container. Place the block before the cup. Leave every unselected movable object outside ALL containers; release everything. Each named preference has one fixed user choice; an undisclosed preference is unknown. For the block, use item_45854dd339. For the cup, use item_1d910e756c.
cases.observed_problem: Answer, successful block action and measured partial goal are present; planner removes the already-correct block and cycles.
cases.interpretation: No evidence of missing public history or physical failure; candidate causes are role/destination binding and failure to preserve a partial goal. Internal reasoning is unobserved.

prior_demo_difference: Phase2 pack demo has a known cup with no block-before-cup edge. The current packing failure adds a blocked known later subgoal. Phase3 selected-container video places cup first in an independent-order task; current failure is block-first and destination-dependent.
confounds: Previous success on a layout/goal ordering never proves robust performance for new aliases, disclosures and DAG constraints.
